pages.title: Chibi Tiger Harry Potter with Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute chibi Harry Potter with tiger ears and a striped tail casts magic with his wand in this printable coloring page while wearing a robe.

pages.title: Chibi Harry Potter with Two Owls Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling chibi Harry Potter sits outdoors surrounded by two perched owls in this printable coloring page, with sparkling stars in the background.

pages.title: Chibi Harry Potter with Hedwig on His Shoulder Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features chibi Harry Potter holding his striped scarf, with Hedwig perched on his shoulder, round glasses, a floating wand, and sparkling stars.

pages.title: Chibi Harry Potter Sitting with Owls Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute chibi Harry Potter sits wrapped in a scarf with two small owls beside him in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Harry Potter Hugging Hedwig the Owl Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter cuddles Hedwig in this printable coloring page, smiling with his eyes closed behind round glasses while wearing Hogwarts robes, with floating hearts around them.

pages.title: Harry Potter Raising Magic Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: Determined young Harry Potter holds up his magic wand in this printable coloring page, wearing round glasses, a Gryffindor robe, and a school tie.

pages.title: Harry Potter and Ron in a Snowy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter and Ron Weasley walk together in this printable coloring page, wearing thick scarves and winter coats beside snow-covered buildings and a hanging witch sign.

pages.title: Harry Potter in Scarf and Robe Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Harry Potter wears round glasses and a striped scarf in this printable coloring page, featuring his wizard robe and house crest.

pages.title: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione December Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter, Ron Weasley, and Hermione Granger pose together in this printable coloring page, with winter scarves, Hermione's books, and a decorative December border.

pages.title: Harry Potter Ron Weasley Draco Malfoy Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter sits atop Draco Malfoy and Ron Weasley holding a glowing box in this printable coloring page filled with playful wizarding students.

pages.title: Chibi Harry Potter, Hermione and Ron Walking Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, and Ron Weasley walk together in this printable coloring page, wearing Hogwarts scarves as Harry carries a wand and Ron holds a rat.

pages.title: Harry Potter Ron Weasley Hermione Granger Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermione Granger holds textbooks while talking to Harry Potter and a frowning Ron Weasley in this printable coloring page, with all three wearing striped scarves.

pages.title: Harry Potter, Hermione and Ron on a Stone Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Harry Potter leads Hermione and Ron across a stone bridge in this printable coloring page, with their wands, Hogwarts Castle, and a flying Golden Snitch.

pages.title: Harry Potter Wearing Sorting Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A nervous Harry Potter wearing the Sorting Hat is pointed at with a wand in this printable coloring page set inside the Great Hall.

pages.title: Chibi Harry Potter Sitting with Hedwig Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features chibi Harry Potter sitting beside Hedwig the owl, wearing round glasses, a plaid jacket, and sneakers against a dotted circular background.
